name: Pi

permissions.label: 全部工具
permissions.hint: 可以改文件、执行任意命令；Pi 没有确认环节，只在信任的项目里用

permissions.label: 只改文件
permissions.hint: 可以读写文件，不能执行命令

permissions.label: 只读
permissions.hint: 只能读代码和搜索，不能改文件、不能执行命令

args.why: 项目设置里信任了这个项目：Pi 无界面运行时不弹信任询问，默认跳过项目里的 .pi 配置、扩展、Skill（Pi 1.5 docs/security.md）

rpcArgs.why: 项目设置里信任了这个项目：Pi 无界面运行时不弹信任询问，默认跳过项目里的 .pi 配置、扩展、Skill（Pi 1.5 docs/security.md）

docsNote: Pi 每次启动读项目目录和上级目录里的 AGENTS.md（没有时读 CLAUDE.md），以及 ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md。

options.label: 离线运行
options.desc: Pi 自己不联网，模型请求照常
options.hint: 不让 Pi 自己联网（例如刷新模型列表），模型请求不受影响（PI_OFFLINE=1）

options.label: codemode 和工具搜索
options.hint: 让模型写脚本批量调用工具、按需搜索工具；MCP 工具多时省上下文

options.label: 长时间提示词缓存
options.desc: 提示词缓存保留更久，长任务更省
options.hint: 支持的服务商把提示词缓存保留更久（PI_CACHE_RETENTION=long），长任务里两轮之间隔得久也能命中缓存

options.label: 关闭匿名统计
options.desc: 不发 Pi 的匿名统计
options.hint: 不发 Pi 的安装、更新匿名统计，请求里也不带来源标记（PI_TELEMETRY=0）；关着时跟随 Pi 自己的设置

configSettings.label: 自动重试
configSettings.hint: 模型请求临时失败（限流、断线、服务器出错）时 Pi 自己重试，面板显示「正在重试」

configSettings.label: 最多重试几次
configSettings.hint: Pi 自己重试的次数上限

configSettings.label: 请求空闲超时
configSettings.hint: 模型这么久没有任何输出就断开重试；中转慢、思考很久的模型可以调大，0 是不限

configSettings.label: Pi 自己的自动压缩
configSettings.hint: 上下文快满时 Pi 自己压缩（剩不到 16384 token 时）。面板的「自动压缩」按比例在一轮结束后压缩，两个都开着时先到的那个起作用

configSettings.label: 缓存预热
configSettings.hint: 保持服务商的提示词缓存不过期。「两轮之间也保持」适合保活的对话，会多花一点钱

configSettings.label: codemode 呈现方式
configSettings.hint: 「只通过 codemode」把内置和扩展的工具都收进 codemode，MCP 工具很多时更省上下文；要先打开上面的「codemode 和工具搜索」

configSettings.label: 不发图片
configSettings.hint: 不把图片发给模型；用只支持文字的中转时打开

configSettings.label: 传输方式
configSettings.hint: 服务商同时支持几种连接方式时用哪种；有的服务商用 WebSocket 更稳

auth.accountNote: Pi 的账号登录只能在终端里做：运行 pi，输入 /login 选择 Claude Pro/Max、ChatGPT、GitHub Copilot 等订阅登录。登录后回到这里保存，就能在多个账号之间切换。也可以在上面的「环境变量」里填 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、OPENAI_API_KEY 等。

beforeEnd.why: 写在每轮用 -e 加载的桥接扩展里：agent_before_settle 返回 continue=true 时 Pi 在同一次运行里接着跑（Pi 1.5.0 源码 agent-session.js 的 _runBeforeSettleBoundary）。Pi 没有钩子配置文件，也不装第三方续跑扩展

tool.before.why: 桥接扩展的 tool_call 返回 block=true 时这次调用不执行，reason 作为报错交给模型（Pi 1.5 文档 extensions.md）

tool.after.why: tool_result 返回的 content 替换这次的结果：补的说明接在原结果后面

context.restored.why: session_compact 之后用 sendMessage(steer) 补一条不显示的消息，下一次请求前交给模型

trust.why: Pi 1.5 docs/security.md「Project trust without an interactive prompt」：print / JSON / RPC 模式没有命令行覆盖或已保存的决定时按跳过处理；AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 不受影响；.agents/skills 从工作目录往上找到仓库根目录为止（docs/skills.md）

en.提示词缓存保留更久，长任务更省: Keep prompt cache longer for long tasks
en.Pi 自己不联网，模型请求照常: Pi stays offline; model requests still work
en.读 mcp.json 连接你配的 MCP 服务器；面板「MCP 工具」页配给 P: Reads mcp.json and connects your MCP servers; servers you give Pi on the panel's MCP tools page depend on it. The panel's own tools are not affected
en.让模型写脚本批量调用工具；关掉后设置里的「codemode 和工具搜索」也用不了: Lets the model write scripts that call tools in batches. When off, "Codemode and tool search" in settings won't work either
en.按需搜索工具，工具很多时省上下文: Searches for tools on demand; saves context when there are many tools
en.本机 llama.cpp 模型的接入和 /llama 命令；不用本机模型可以关掉: Local llama.cpp models and the /llama command; turn off if you don't use local models
en.可以改文件、执行任意命令；Pi 没有确认环节，只在信任的项目里用: Can edit files and run any command. Pi never asks for confirmation, so use it only in trusted projects
en.可以读写文件，不能执行命令: Can read and write files, but can't run commands
en.只能读代码和搜索，不能改文件、不能执行命令: Can only read and search code; no edits and no commands
en.Pi 每次启动读项目目录和上级目录里的 AGENTS.md（没有时读 CLAUD: Pi reads AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md when there is none) in the project and its parent directories, plus ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md, on every start.
en.Pi 的账号登录只能在终端里做：运行 pi，输入 /login 选择 Claud: Pi accounts can only be signed in from a terminal: run pi and type /login to sign in with a Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar subscription. Then come back here and save it to switch between accounts. You can also set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and so on under Environment variables above.
en.不让 Pi 自己联网（例如刷新模型列表），模型请求不受影响（PI_OFFLINE: Stops Pi's own network activity, such as model catalog refreshes. Model requests are not affected (PI_OFFLINE=1)
en.让模型写脚本批量调用工具、按需搜索工具；MCP 工具多时省上下文: Lets the model write scripts that call tools in batches and search for tools on demand. Saves context when there are many MCP tools
en.npm:@scope/包名、git:github.com/用户/仓库 或本机目录: npm:@scope/name, git:github.com/user/repo, or a local folder
en.web_search 搜网页，fetch_content 读网页、GitHub: web_search searches the web; fetch_content reads pages, GitHub repos, PDFs and videos. Works without a key (uses Exa's free search by default)
en.要换搜索源或填密钥，写在 ~/.pi/agent/web-search.json: To switch providers or add keys, edit ~/.pi/agent/web-search.json
en.web_search 直接用当前模型服务商自己的搜索（Anthropic、Ope: web_search uses the current model provider's own search (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek and more), with no third-party search service
en.和「联网搜索」都提供 web_search，二选一装；走的是模型服务商的接口，第: Also provides web_search, so install either this or Web search, not both. It calls the model provider's own API, which third-party relays may not support
en.执行前拦下 git reset --hard、rm -rf 这类不可撤销的命令，: Blocks irreversible commands such as git reset --hard and rm -rf, and reads of secrets like SSH keys and .env files, before they run. Pi itself never asks for confirmation
en.用语言服务器（LSP）检查改过的文件、给出报错位置，能自动修的直接修: Checks edited files with language servers (LSP), reports exact error locations, and applies fixes the server supports
en.要先把对应语言的语言服务器装到 PATH（例如 typescript-langu: Install the language servers you need on PATH first (for example typescript-language-server or pyright); it does not download them
en.支持的服务商把提示词缓存保留更久（PI_CACHE_RETENTION=long: Providers that support it keep the prompt cache longer (PI_CACHE_RETENTION=long), so long tasks still hit the cache after a long gap between turns
en.不发 Pi 的安装、更新匿名统计，请求里也不带来源标记（PI_TELEMETRY: Stops Pi's anonymous install and update reports and its provider attribution headers (PI_TELEMETRY=0). When off, Pi's own setting applies
en.Pi 已经内置 MCP，面板的「MCP 工具」页也能直接配，不用再装: Pi already has MCP built in, and the panel's MCP tools page can configure it directly; no need to install this
en.和面板的子对话、子任务重复：面板派活、合并、评审都靠自己的子对话: Overlaps with the panel's sub-conversations and subtasks: the panel delegates, merges and reviews with its own sub-conversations
en.和面板的提问重复：面板已经给 Pi 提供了 ask_user: Overlaps with the panel's questions: the panel already gives Pi ask_user
en.和面板的执行计划重复：面板用 set_plan 显示和推进计划: Overlaps with the panel's plan: the panel shows and drives plans with set_plan
en.模型请求临时失败（限流、断线、服务器出错）时 Pi 自己重试，面板显示「正在重试: Pi retries model requests that fail temporarily (rate limits, dropped connections, server errors); the panel shows "Retrying"
en.Pi 自己重试的次数上限: How many times Pi retries on its own
en.模型这么久没有任何输出就断开重试；中转慢、思考很久的模型可以调大，0 是不限: Disconnects and retries when the model produces nothing for this long. Raise it for slow relays or models that think for a long time; 0 means no limit
en.上下文快满时 Pi 自己压缩（剩不到 16384 token 时）。面板的「自动: Pi compacts on its own when the context is nearly full (fewer than 16384 tokens left). The panel's Auto-compact compacts by percentage after a turn; with both on, whichever comes first applies
en.保持服务商的提示词缓存不过期。「两轮之间也保持」适合保活的对话，会多花一点钱: Keeps the provider's prompt cache from expiring. "Also between turns" suits kept-alive conversations and costs a little more
en.「只通过 codemode」把内置和扩展的工具都收进 codemode，MCP: "Only through codemode" moves built-in and extension tools into codemode, which saves context when there are many MCP tools. Turn on "Codemode and tool search" above first
en.不把图片发给模型；用只支持文字的中转时打开: Doesn't send images to the model. Turn on for text-only relays
en.服务商同时支持几种连接方式时用哪种；有的服务商用 WebSocket 更稳: Which connection to use when a provider supports several; WebSocket is more stable with some providers

recommended.note: 和「联网搜索」都提供 web_search，二选一装；走的是模型服务商的接口，第三方中转不一定支持

recommended.name: 危险命令拦截
recommended.desc: 执行前拦下 git reset --hard、rm -rf 这类不可撤销的命令，以及读 SSH 密钥、.env 这类机密文件；Pi 自己没有确认环节

recommended.name: 代码诊断
recommended.desc: 用语言服务器（LSP）检查改过的文件、给出报错位置，能自动修的直接修
